sn17.28:1.3: Lābhasakkārasiloko bhikkhave chaviṃ chindati || chaviṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindati || cammaṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindati || maṃsaṃ chetvā nahāruṃ chindati || nahāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindati || aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati || || 4
sn17.28:1.4: Evaṃ dāruno kho bhikkhave lābhasakkarāsiloko || pe || || 5
